translations.web: I will go down with you into Egypt. I will also surely bring you up again. Joseph’s hand will close your eyes.”
translations.bsb: I will go down with you to Egypt, and I will surely bring you back. And Joseph’s own hands will close your eyes.”
translations.kjv: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.
